name: Tiana's Place Rocky Road Ice Cream Sundae
whyItWorks: Combines high-lactose chocolate ice cream with sharp roasted almond/walnut pieces that scrape inflamed mucosa.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip the Rocky Road sundae and ask your server for a plain scoop of vanilla ice cream with marshamallow/fudge sauce and zero nuts.
watchOuts: Sharp whole/chopped nuts in Rocky Road ice cream
